witnesses.name: Witness A
witnesses.positionCitation: witness_A.txt p.1; facts.txt p.1 F30 (driving westbound in outside lane about 0.25 mi / 402 m east of the truck)
witnesses.claim: Looking down the road ahead of me, I saw a dark car come over the hill on the other side, eastbound, coming toward the intersection... Once the trailer was out across the eastbound lanes, it blocked my view of the car. I didn't see the car hit the trailer.

witnesses.name: Witness B
witnesses.positionCitation: Depo 27:05 (red X marked on Exhibit 4 at the SE corner where the US-27A eastbound shoulder meets the east edge of NE 140th Court, northwest of the bench shelter)
witnesses.claim: I had a clear view of the car the whole way in. I watched it right up until the moment it hit. Nothing was in the way.

witnesses.name: Witness C
witnesses.positionCitation: witness_C.txt p.1 (stopped in pickup in westbound inside lane of US-27A, marked position about 18 m west of the side road)
witnesses.claim: I was watching the truck, not the other side of the road, because I figured I'd go once it cleared. I never heard brakes, tires or a horn before the bang. It was one loud crunch, and then I saw the car come out the far side heading east and leave the road toward the houses.

notes: 1. Witness B spoken vs. marked position (Depo 09:04, 27:04, 27:05): Earlier in her testimony (Depo 09:04) Witness B states she was waiting at the bench shelter in front of the store, and at Depo 27:04 she says aloud 'I was over by the corner, near the shelter.' However, on the video at Depo 27:05 she places her red 'X' on Exhibit 4 at the pavement corner where the US-27A eastbound shoulder meets the east edge of NE 140th Court (approximately [2.0, 6.0] m from the AOI), about 7 m northwest of the bench shelter ([8.0, 10.0] m). 2. Witness B prior statements vs. deposition claim (police_report.txt p.3; Depo 27:47, 28:17, 28:50-29:27): At the deposition Witness B insists she had a clear, unobstructed view of the front of the car during the last second right up until it went under the trailer. In her brief oral statement at the scene (police_report.txt p.3) and her written statement a few days later (Depo 29:16), she did not state that she watched the car all the way to impact. Moreover, because the tractor had already entered NE 140th Court and the semitrailer was stretched across both eastbound lanes (Depo 24:09) while the car was in the outside (southernmost) eastbound lane, the geometry between her marked position [2.0, 6.0] and the approaching car should be checked for line-of-sight / perspective consistency. 3. Inferred eye heights: Eye heights are not stated in the evidence and are inferred as 1.2 m for Witness A (car driver), 1.6 m for Witness B (standing adult pedestrian per Depo 27:24), and ~1.5 m (or 1.2-1.8 m) for Witness C (seated in a pickup truck). 4. Inferred positions along Z (north-south) for Witnesses A and C: Derived from US-27A road cross-section geometry in facts.txt F6-F8 (AOI at center of EB outside lane; EB inside lane -3.66 m; 78 ft / 23.77 m median + turn lane + shoulders from -5.49 m to -29.26 m; WB inside lane center ~ -26.8 m; WB outside lane center ~ -30.5 m).
